Home.title: New in Kraków? Ask in your own words.
Home.subtitle: The AI assistant answers from official BIP service cards and shows you on the map where to get it done. Every answer links to its source.

modules.title: Assistant
modules.desc: Ask in English, Polish or Ukrainian. Get the list of documents, fees, processing time and an online booking link – from the official service card.

modules.title: Kraków in 15 minutes
modules.desc: Enter your flat’s address and see nurseries, preschools, schools, parks, libraries and stops within 15 minutes on foot or by public transport – with an accessibility index.

modules.title: First steps
modules.desc: A to-do list of formalities in the right order, matched to your situation.

Welcome.title: Welcome to Oswój Kraków
Welcome.intro: We help new residents find their way around Kraków quickly.
Welcome.point1: Ask about an official matter – the answer comes from the official BIP service card.
Welcome.point2: See city offices, nurseries, preschools, schools, parks and stops on the map.
Welcome.point3: Check what is within 15 minutes of your address.
Welcome.disclaimer: This is an information service, not legal advice. Do not enter personal data.
Welcome.sources: Kraków Open Data, BIP service cards, MSIP, ZTP (public transport), OpenStreetMap.
